**Genesis** is already working to launch an updated version of its flagship sedan to be launched in 2025.

The G90 facelift will sure be a interesting model to look forward to as Genesis could implement the new design language anticipated by the Neolun concept car, that also previews the GV90, the SUV version of brand’s flagship.
The G90 is likely to adopt a refreshed front fascia, including a wider, more prominent grille and redesigned headlamps, aligning with the brand’s evolving design language.
This mirrors the GV80’s recent updates, which showcase a shallower, wider grille and hidden exhaust pipes for a sleeker appearance.
Inside, the G90 may incorporate a new 27-inch OLED display that integrates digital gauges and the infotainment system, similar to the GV80’s latest interior upgrades.
This setup enhances user experience with a seamless, high-resolution interface.
The G90 could see powertrain enhancements, potentially offering a more robust engine lineup.
Drawing from the GV80’s updates, the base 2.5-liter 4-cylinder engine now produces 304 hp, and the 3.5-liter V6 generates 380 hp, indicating a trend towards increased performance across the lineup.

Expect the G90 to be equipped with state-of-the-art safety systems and driver assistance technologies, such as Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist and Remote Smart Parking Assist, features that are becoming standard in Genesis vehicles.
Both models have embraced a more refined and dynamic aesthetic, with the GV80 Coupe introducing a sportier silhouette and the G80 featuring updated multi-LED pixel lamps.
The G90 is expected to follow suit with design elements that convey luxury and performance.

The introduction of larger, high-resolution OLED displays and the integration of advanced infotainment systems in the GV80 and G80 suggest that the G90 will also feature cutting-edge technology to enhance driver and passenger experience.
We don’t expect more updates regarding the engine line-up unless Genesis uses this facelift to launch its new hybrid engine that is **currently under development**.
In conclusion, the 2025 Genesis G90 is set to incorporate a series of substantial upgrades, drawing from the successful enhancements seen in the GV80 and G80 models.
These improvements are poised to reinforce the G90’s position in the luxury sedan segment, offering consumers a blend of sophisticated design, advanced technology, and robust performance.
